summary.headline: The Planning Board advanced site plan reviews for 22 and 154 Turnpike Road and reviewed town zoning enforcement procedures.
summary.summary: The Southborough Planning Board continued public hearings for site plan modifications at 22 Turnpike Road and 154 Turnpike Road, granting an occupancy sign-off recommendation for the interior of Chase Bank at the latter location. Members also reviewed ongoing drafting of zoning enforcement policies and non-compliance tracking procedures in coordination with the building department. In the planner's report, town staff provided updates on Costco variances before the Zoning Board of Appeals, new state zoning legislation, and upcoming potential warrant articles for Town Meeting.

topics.title: Subdivision rules and regulations update
topics.summary: A board member reported on drafting updates to the town's subdivision rules and regulations. Draft language has been shared with staff and the town planner for preliminary review before being scheduled for full board discussion.
key_details: Draft submitted to town staff on July 12, 2026.
Working group will meet to refine the draft before placing it on a future Planning Board agenda.
topics.outcome: Discussion only; item will return to a future agenda after working group review.

topics.title: Planning Board role in zoning enforcement and complaint procedures
topics.summary: The board reviewed a draft zoning enforcement policy and an enforcement complaint form developed after meeting with the building commissioner. Members discussed staff workflow, statutory references under Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 40A and local zoning Chapter 174, and the development of an internal master spreadsheet to monitor site plan compliance across town projects.
key_details: A subcommittee met with Building Commissioner Mark Robidoux and town staff to clarify enforcement protocols.
Procedures reference Southborough Code Chapter 174-24 and MGL Chapter 40A Section 7.
Staff is building a master spreadsheet of standardized project conditions to track compliance across town departments.
Board members noted the citizen complaint form will be used by the public via the town website, while Planning Board concerns will be communicated via direct staff correspondence.
topics.outcome: Draft will be refined with corrected statutory citations and brought back for further discussion in August.

topics.title: 22 Turnpike Road public hearing continuation
topics.summary: The board considered a request from the applicant for the golf range modification to major site plan approval at 22 Turnpike Road to continue the hearing without testimony. Members noted concern over the high number of continuances on active development applications and discussed options for managing review timelines or instituting continuance fees in the future.
key_details: Project address is 22 Turnpike Road (golf range modification).
Applicant requested a continuance without testimony to prepare revised materials addressing consultant comments.
Board discussed tracking whether delays stem from board review or applicant requests.
topics.outcome: Continued the public hearing to August 17, 2026, at 6:45 p.m., and extended the board's decision deadline to September 18, 2026.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes from June 22, 2026, with typographical corrections.
key_details: Minutes of June 22, 2026, approved as amended.

topics.title: 154 Turnpike Road site plan modification and Chase Bank occupancy
topics.summary: The board discussed exterior site plan compliance for 154 Turnpike Road, focusing on proposed dimmer modules to bring existing non-compliant site lighting into conformance. The board agreed to allow the town planner to recommend approval of an occupancy permit for the interior tenant, Chase Bank, whose interior fit-out meets prior site plan conditions, while continuing the overall site plan modification hearing to September.
key_details: Address is 154 Turnpike Road, former Tomasso restaurant space being converted to Chase Bank.
Applicant ordered dimming modules from the light manufacturer to reduce site lumens and hardscape illumination levels.
Chase Bank interior alterations were approved under an October 2025 change-of-use site plan approval.
Board supported town planner signing off on the certificate of occupancy for Chase Bank upon receipt of an engineer-stamped certification letter.
Full exterior modification hearing regarding lighting and landscaping continued to September 14, 2026.
topics.outcome: Board authorized the planner to sign off on Chase Bank interior occupancy; continued the public hearing to September 14, 2026, at 6:45 p.m., and extended the decision deadline to October 2, 2026.

topics.title: Planner's report and upcoming zoning articles
topics.summary: The town planner gave updates on ongoing developments, upcoming Zoning Board of Appeals hearings, state legislative changes, and potential future town meeting warrant articles. Items included light pole height and retaining wall variances for Costco, a consolidated public hearing for National Grid's vegetation management plan, state zoning bill H.5555, MBTA Communities regulations, and potential bylaw proposals regarding signs along Route 9, two-family conversions, and short-term rentals.
key_details: Costco is scheduled before the ZBA on July 15, 2026, for variances concerning 20-foot light pole height limits and retaining walls exceeding 6 feet in the setback.
National Grid's vegetation management plan will be reviewed in a joint hearing with the tree warden on August 17, 2026.
State House Bill 5555 zoning amendments took effect July 1, 2026, and are being reviewed by town counsel.
A proposed two-family conversion bylaw is being targeted for the 2026 Special Town Meeting in October, with public hearings expected in September.

Potential 2027 Annual Town Meeting topics discussed include Route 9 signage special permits, short-term rental regulations, 55-plus housing bylaws, and giving the building commissioner explicit authority to revoke certificates of occupancy.
topics.outcome: Information shared; staff will draft items for upcoming meetings.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing for 22 Turnpike Road to August 17, 2026, at 6:45 p.m.
Extend the deadline for Planning Board action on 22 Turnpike Road to September 18, 2026.
Continue the public hearing for 154 Turnpike Road to September 14, 2026, at 6:45 p.m.
Extend the deadline for Planning Board action on 154 Turnpike Road to October 2, 2026.
